integrity: Exact proof and a separate finite-script regression are both embedded. No external or independent audit was performed. Priority beyond consulted literature is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Only complex chain-polytope toric varieties of three antichains with \(a,b\ge2\) and \(c\ge1\); only the identity component. When \(c=1\) the unipotent radical is nonabelian; when \(c\ge2\) it is abelian. The finite checker tests bounded lattice characters and does not replace the symbolic proof.
title: A middle-tier phase transition for unipotent automorphisms of three-level chain-polytope toric varieties
